method: Worklist from `python -m app.cli export-food-merchant-worklist`. Per merchant: the Google Maps branch page for identity only (name and address compared, Place ID read from the expanded URL); a DuckDuckGo html search for the official site, opened and checked for the shop name, this branch's address and that it still operates; a tourism-board or government page about that one merchant on the trusted registry hosts; the 商圈 chosen from the destination's areas by address; up to three categories from the official page. Every cited page was opened; quotes are exact visible text.

rules.sources: Only the merchant's own site (merchant_official / merchant_website), a tourism-board or government page about that one merchant (official_tourism / merchant_listing), or Wikimedia. Google, Naver, Michelin, Tabelog, Gurunavi, HotPepper, Retty, OpenRice, CatchTable and social pages are never sources; *.gorp.jp official pages count as merchant_website.
rules.address: Taken only from a cited official site or listing page, never from Google Maps.
rules.google: The Maps page is used for identity (name and address match) and for the Place ID in its URL; nothing else from Google is stored.
rules.coordinates: Never proposed here; fill-food-merchant-coordinates reads the new pages afterwards.
rules.korea: Naver is unreachable in the browser pane; recorded as not_possible_in_pane.
rules.not_found: The searches made are listed as evidence so the merchant is not researched twice.
